caption:
The next generation of aviation got a hands-on introduction in Wichita. ✈️🔧

Nearly 1,500 middle and high school students from 40 area schools explored aviation careers at Textron Aviation’s National Manufacturing Day event, held October 1–2.

Across 26 interactive booths, students explored a Cessna Turbo Skylane cockpit, watched a wind-tunnel demonstration, assembled a keepsake and tried activities involving flight simulation, circuits and aircraft technology.

Nearly 150 employees volunteered each day to share what their work looks like—and how students might find their own place in aviation.

Flying is only part of the story. Every aircraft also needs people who design, build, maintain and support it. Giving students a chance to try those skills can make an aviation career feel possible.

Here’s to opening hangar doors—and opening minds. 💛
